sections.description: Visual Designer Manager V3 med V1 som funktionel og visuel reference.
sections.changelog: 3.0.0-alpha.21: Persistent Website-menu + Header binding. VDM Menu is a single integrated editor, Website-menu has an explicit save action, edit-menu selection is separate, active Website-menu is protected from deletion, and Menu nodes default to the canonical Website-menu source with optional Specific-menu override.
